emergence.summary: An X-linked single-gene ATP7A loss-of-function disables the copper-transporting P-type ATPase that drives dietary copper OUT of enterocytes into the portal blood, transports copper across the blood-brain barrier, and delivers copper to the secretory pathway for cuproenzymes. Without it, absorbed copper is trapped in the gut mucosa and cannot reach the body and brain, so SYSTEMIC and CNS copper is DEFICIENT and copper-dependent enzymes (lysyl oxidase, dopamine-beta-hydroxylase, cytochrome-c oxidase) fail -> connective-tissue, vascular and severe neurodegenerative disease (the axis -- systemic/CNS copper delivery -- is driven DOWN). Read as a lost ACCELERATOR of systemic copper delivery (ATP7A DRIVES copper into the body; LOF -> drive lost -> copper delivery under-driven), the deficiency-driven DOWN shape. This is the EXACT CONTRAST to Wilson disease, the sibling copper ATPase ATP7B: Wilson is copper axis UP (released brake -> toxic copper accumulation -> RESTRAIN/chelate), Menkes is copper axis DOWN (lost accelerator -> copper deficiency -> REPLACE) -- the SAME metal, the OPPOSITE sign AND the OPPOSITE lever (replace vs chelate). The kit re-derives the corrective direction, which SUPPLIES copper downstream of the broken transporter rather than restoring it: parenteral copper-histidine (copper histidinate) delivers copper directly into the blood, bypassing the intestinal ATP7A defect. HONEST status caveat: copper-histidine is a long-standing clinical / orphan therapy (used since Sarkar's work in the 1970s-80s), NOT a conventional small-molecule regulatory approval, and its benefit is partial and genotype-dependent -- it helps mainly when started very early and where residual transporter or accessible CNS delivery remains (the blood-brain-barrier ATP7A defect limits CNS rescue); efficacy is held [O]. Restoring ATP7A itself (gene / transporter therapy) is investigational. The gamma read is of the ATP7A locus switch STRUCTURE (an AT-leaning promoter, beside its Wilson sibling ATP7B); the disease lesion is coding/structural (missense / splice / deletion), outside the promoter firewall. X-linked, so penetrance/severity are zygosity-dependent and held [O]. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: systemic and CNS copper delivery (intestinal copper efflux into the body + blood-brain-barrier transport feeding the cuproenzymes) -- the copper-DEFICIENCY contrast to Wilson's copper-accumulation axis

per_gene.note: ATP7A is a copper-transporting P-type ATPase that drives dietary copper out of enterocytes into the portal circulation, transports copper across the blood-brain barrier, and delivers copper to the trans-Golgi secretory pathway for cuproenzyme loading. As a positive DRIVER (accelerator) of systemic copper delivery, its LOF LOSES the drive -> copper is trapped in the gut and cannot reach the body/brain -> systemic and CNS copper DEFICIENCY and cuproenzyme failure. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding lesion (firewall). The pathological axis is COPPER DELIVERY (it goes DOWN), so the corrective levers RAISE it. Xq21.1 (OMIM 300011). NCBI official symbol ATP7A. The sibling efflux ATPase ATP7B (Wilson) brakes copper accumulation -> the exact opposite-sign copper disease.
per_gene.src: Vulpe 1993 Nat Genet 3:7; Chelly 1993 Nat Genet 3:14; Mercer 1993 Nat Genet 3:20 (ATP7A / Menkes cloned)

falsifiers.claim: ATP7A LOF (lost accelerator) LOWERS systemic/CNS copper delivery (axis DOWN)
falsifiers.falsifier: an ATP7A null allele that RAISED systemic/CNS copper or cuproenzyme activity would refute the lost-accelerator/deficiency direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: serum copper / ceruloplasmin and cuproenzyme activity (lysyl oxidase, dopamine-beta-hydroxylase) by ATP7A genotype

falsifiers.claim: supplying copper downstream of the transporter (replace) is the CORRECTIVE direction (raises delivery)
falsifiers.falsifier: if parenteral copper-histidine LOWERED, or failed to raise, systemic copper / cuproenzyme activity, the replace-copper lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: serum copper / cuproenzyme response to parenteral copper-histidine

falsifiers.claim: Menkes is the OPPOSITE-sign copper disease to Wilson (deficiency vs accumulation; replace vs chelate)
falsifiers.falsifier: if copper chelation (the Wilson lever) improved Menkes, or copper repletion improved Wilson, the opposite-sign pairing of the two copper ATPases would be refuted
falsifiers.measurable_by: tissue copper and clinical course under copper repletion vs chelation in each disorder

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
